Landing.heroSubtitle: A simple prediction game that turns into a real biathlon strategy game.
Landing.featuresEyebrow: Easy to play, rich to master
Landing.f1Title: A simple game: 3 biathletes per race
Landing.f1Body: Before each race, pick 3 biathletes. 30 seconds is all it takes, and you can change your mind until the start.
Landing.f1Pin1: The odds: the higher they are, the more the biathlete earns. Dare to back the outsider?
Landing.f1Pin2: Your 3 picks, that's it. A biathlete you pick is "burned" for the next race of the stage: mix up your choices.
Landing.f1Pin3: Predictions close when the race starts.
Landing.f2Title: You score if your biathletes finish in the Top 10
Landing.f2Body: Each biathlete earns their odds multiplied according to their place. Hundreds of points are at stake in every race.
Landing.f2Pin1: Just like the World Cup, winning pays: odds × 25 for 1st, down to × 1 for 10th.
Landing.f2Pin2: A well-placed outsider earns more than a winning favourite.
Landing.f2Pin3: Bonus if your 3 picks finish in the Top 10 (+20), Top 5 (+50) or on the podium (+100). And +200 for the perfect prediction.
Landing.f3Body: Create your league, share the code and follow your own ranking, on top of the overall standings.
Landing.f3Pin1: A code to send to your friends, family or colleagues so they can join you.
Landing.f3Pin2: Yellow bib for the season leader, red bib for the best player of each stage.
Landing.f3Pin3: You, neck and neck: every race can change everything.
Landing.f4Body: Special stages with bonuses or penalties, bonus cards, World Championships that count double: the standings stay open until the last race.
Landing.f4Pin1: Special races, announced in advance, change the rules: here, every penalty loop costs you points.
Landing.f4Pin2: Score points in 10 races in a row and win a bonus card, to play whenever you choose.
Landing.f4Pin3: The World Championships count double, and you have 3 ×2 boosts to use during the season.
Landing.mockSpecialRule: −20 pts per penalty loop of your biathletes
Landing.faqTitle: Everything to know before the start
Landing.faq_free_a: Yes, 100%. No real money, no cash prizes: you play for fun, glory and the yellow bib.
Landing.faq_account_q: Do I need an account to start?
Landing.faq_account_a: Not right away. Tap "I'm in": the next race opens and you make your picks. You're only asked for an account when you confirm, with a simple code sent by email, no password.
Landing.faq_when_q: Until when can I make or change my picks?
Landing.faq_when_a: Predictions for a stage open one week before it starts. You can change them as often as you like until each race starts, then they're locked.
Landing.faq_points_q: How many points can I win on a race?
Landing.faq_points_a: Hundreds. Each Top 10 biathlete earns their odds multiplied according to their place: × 25 for the winner, × 18 for 2nd… down to × 1 for 10th. Like the World Cup scale, it rewards winning first and foremost. A biathlete with odds of 9 who wins already brings in 225 points, before the Top 10, Top 5, Podium and Perfect prediction bonuses.
Landing.faq_relays_a: Yes. On a relay you pick a nation, and only the top 5 score (odds × 10 for the win). There are fewer points at stake than in individual races, so consistency makes the difference.
Landing.faq_burnt_a: A biathlete you picked isn't available for the next race of the same stage. Mix up your choices and save your favourites for the right moment. Everyone is available again at the next stage, and the Meltdown card lets you bypass the rule once.
Landing.faq_mistakes_q: What if I miss a race or get it wrong?
Landing.faq_mistakes_a: You're allowed mistakes. At the end of the season, your 3 worst individual race results and your 2 worst relays are dropped, starting with the races you didn't play. Only the World Championships and Olympics are never dropped.
Landing.faq_special_a: Some races, announced in advance, have an exceptional rule. Penalty loop: each penalty loop by your biathletes costs 20 points. Fog: a biathlete outside the Top 10 costs you as many points as their place. Busted: penalty if your picks finish outside the Top 10. National Day: biathletes from your favourite team earn double.
Landing.faq_cards_q: How do I win bonus cards?
Landing.faq_cards_a: By scoring points in 10 races in a row, relays included: that's the 10/10. You then pick your card, for example Boost (×3 on one biathlete), Meltdown (un-burn your biathletes) or 4th pick (4 biathletes, the best 3 count). Play it at the right time to turn the standings upside down.
Landing.faq_team_a: Pick your colours for the season, for example France Women or Norway Men, and follow their wins and podiums from your home page. Your team can also earn you points: double on National Day, and with the Team card at the end of the season.
Landing.faq_standings_a: The overall standings add up all your points of the season: the leader wears the yellow bib. After each stage, a stage ranking decides who wears the red bib. And every league has its own ranking.
Landing.faq_worlds_q: Can the standings still change late in the season?
Landing.faq_worlds_a: Yes, and that's the whole point. The World Championships count double, a well-played bonus card can earn big, and the season globes are awarded at the end of the winter. Nothing is decided before the last race.
Landing.finalSubtitle: Pick your 3 biathletes in 30 seconds and join the race for the yellow bib.
Landing.footerDisclaimer: Biathlonpronos is an independent biathlon prediction game. No real money wagered. No financial winnings.

Regles.title: The rules
Regles.intro: Predict which biathletes will perform, play their odds, and try to grab the Yellow Bib as the season's best predictor.
Regles.baremeHint: Odds × multiplier based on finishing rank. Nothing beyond 10th place.
Regles.s_principe_body: For each individual race, pick 3 biathletes. The riskier your pick (higher odds), the more it can pay off — but it must finish in the Top 10. Combination bonuses: Podium (+100), Top 5 (+50), Top 10 (+20), and a Perfect Pick if you find the 3 highest-scoring biathletes (+200).
Regles.s_grillage_body: A biathlete you pick becomes unavailable for the next race of the same stage. They become available again at the next stage (unless you use the Meltdown card).
Regles.s_cotes_body: Each biathlete has odds per format (sprint/pursuit/individual/mass start), re-evaluated at key points in the season. Pursuit odds are recalculated automatically after the sprint: +5 per 20s of gap (first bracket neutral), capped at 40.
Regles.s_relais_body: You predict a nation instead of 3 biathletes. Only the top 5 nations score, on a reduced scale compared to individual races.
Regles.s_globes_body: Before the season starts: overall winner, best young athlete, and best nation, for both men and women. The overall globe rewards precision on the final Top 5 the most.
Regles.s_bonusx2_body: 3 uses per season, on a World Cup individual race or relay (not on World Champs/Olympics or special races). Doubles every point from that prediction.
Regles.s_mondiaux_body: Every race at these events counts double automatically, not stackable with the personal ×2 bonus.
Regles.s_special_body: Penalty loop: -20 pts per penalty loop by your biathletes. Fog: outside the Top 10, a malus equal to the finishing position. Busted: a malus if one or more of your 3 picks finish outside the Top 10 (up to -300), and -200 if you don't predict at all. National Day (bonus race): your picked biathletes from your favourite team (nation and sex) who finish in the Top 10 score double, not stackable with another ×2 (Boost stays at ×3).
Regles.s_streak_body: 10 consecutive races scoring points (relays included) earn you a bonus card of your choice. The same card can't be taken twice in a row. Meltdown (un-burn your biathletes once), Boost (×3 on one biathlete in an individual race, never ×6 with a ×2) and 4th pick (4 biathletes, best 3 count, over 2 men's and 2 women's races, active right away). From stage 4, Slipstream (your biathletes count one place higher on one race). After the Worlds, Team (until the end of the season, each biathlete of your favourite team in the Top 10 earns you their odds). Ça farte can be played during a 4th pick, Aspiration can't.
Regles.s_pepite_body: A bet placed at the start of the season on an outsider per sex (odds ≥ 30). A hidden pick: on their first Top 10 of the season, their race score is added as a bonus, then they become a regular athlete again.
Regles.s_fuseegachette_body: Rocket (sprint and individual only): +50 pts if one of your picks had the race's best ski time (once). Trigger (pursuit and mass start only): +20 pts per pick with a perfect 20/20 at the range (stackable).
Regles.s_jokers_body: At the end of the season, your 3 worst individual race results and your 2 worst relays are wiped (never the World Championships or Olympics). A race you didn't play is wiped first. Wiping a result removes its points: a 0 costs nothing, a malus is cancelled. Preview during the season in My season.
Regles.s_classement_body: Adds up every point scored over the season. The leader wears the Yellow Bib. The by-stage standings add up the points of a single stage: its leader wears the Red Bib, and each player shows how many stages they have won. Private leagues between friends also exist.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Biathlonpronos ("the Application") respects its users' privacy. This privacy policy explains what personal data is collected, how it is used, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: When you use the Application, we collect:
bullets: Predictions, bonus cards and game history
Sign-in data (email and password, or OAuth provider: Google, Apple, Facebook)
sections.note: We do not collect any bank or payment data: the game is entirely free.

sections.title: 3. Use of data
paragraphs: The data collected is used exclusively to:
bullets: Provide the game features (predictions, standings, globes, leagues)

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
paragraphs: Your personal data is never sold or rented to third parties.
Some data may be processed by our technical providers (hosting, database, authentication) strictly to run the service.

sections.title: 5. Third-party sign-in (OAuth)
paragraphs: The application offers sign-in with Google, Apple and Facebook. These sign-ins are subject to those providers' privacy policies, and we never receive your password. If you sign in by email, your password is stored encrypted by our authentication provider: we never have access to it in plain text.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
paragraphs: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
bullets: Right of access to your personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")

sections.title: 8. Security

RuleInfo.title: How does it work?
RuleInfo.individual: Pick 3 biathletes. Each one scores if they finish in the Top 10: their odds × 25 for a win, × 18 for 2nd place… down to × 1 for 10th. Bonus if your 3 picks all finish in the Top 3, Top 5 or Top 10.
RuleInfo.fusee: Rocket bonus: +50 pts if one of your biathletes has the fastest ski time.
RuleInfo.gachette: Trigger bonus: +20 pts per biathlete who shoots 20/20.
RuleInfo.pursuitStart: Athletes start in the order of the sprint results, and odds are re-evaluated based on the time gap.
RuleInfo.grilled: Biathletes picked for the previous race of the stage are burned: you can't pick them again.
RuleInfo.relay: For relays, pick a single team: it scores if it finishes in the Top 5 (its odds × 10 for a win, then × 6, × 4, × 2 and × 1).
RuleInfo.x2: Until the start, you can change your prediction and activate a ×2 bonus (3 per season).
